_comment: The declared degradations (docs/CONTRACTS.md section 18): every way gnomon carries on with
less than the surface declared, by the id its `degradation` audit records and task-record
`degradations[]` entries carry. A reader filters the trail by these ids, so adding, renaming
or removing one is a contract change. packages/gnomon-core/src/degradation.test.ts asserts
that DEGRADATIONS in degradation.ts declares exactly these ids in this order, that section 18
names each one, and that a `degradation` record carries only the keys below.
benchmarks/degradation-contract measures each id: announced AND recorded.
